subject: lagged influence of binary factors on outcome variable

messages.subject: lagged influence of binary factors on outcome variable
parts:
Dear lavaan usera,

I am looking for advice regarding lagged influence of binary factor on outcome variable at specific time.

For example, I want to know if presence / absense of an infection in last 2 years has any impact on the outcome variable (FEV1 in my case).
I have measurements of the outcome variable in year 1-4 (x1,x2,x3,x4) and data on infection during these years (f1,f2,f3,f4).
What I'm trying to fit is 
  • x2 as a function of f1
  • x3 as function of f1 and f2
  • x4 as a function of f2 and f3
I don't fit x1 as I don't have data on infection before the study.

Model synthax is here:
model ='intercept =~ 1*x1 + 1*x2 + 1*x3 + 1*x4
slope =~ 1*x1 + 2*x2 + 3*x3 + 4*x4
x2 ~ f1
x3 ~ f1 +f2
x4 ~ f2 + f3
'
Unfortunately, I receive warnings:

Warning messages:
1: In lav_samplestats_icov(COV = cov[[g]], ridge = 1e-05, x.idx = x.idx[[g]],  :
  lavaan WARNING: sample covariance matrix is not positive-definite
2: In lavaan::lavaan(model = model, data = for_lavaan, model.type = "growth",  :
  lavaan WARNING:
    Model estimation FAILED! Returning starting values.

Any inputs are greatly appreciated, thanks 

Sincerely,
Dmitrii
